hypothesis: A valid contributor can launder task-specific Adam moments, policy-optimizer moments, and running reward scale into a shared multitask world-model learner; after the contributor exits, a victim update is redirected even when the victim sees its own true trajectory.
attacker_operation: 20 native full updates on legal reacher-easy data, followed by 20 native full victim updates on walker-walk data; no label, observation, reward, or parameter edits.
causal_controls: same source-contaminated model weights with all optimizer and scale state reset
effect_gate: State-retaining return must be at least 100 below both same-model reset and clean victim controls.
gpu_work: Short CUDA native updates and six 500-step native MPC episodes; approximately 2 minutes.
novelty_status: No accepted claim. Persistent optimizer state produced only small return differences and is a generic continual-learning/optimization channel without demonstrated world-model-specific harm.
decision_cn: 保留源任务优化器状态相对同一污染后权重的重置对照只下降0.80分（MPC源）或3.57分（随机源）；相对洁净受害者下降1.32和7.91分，均未达到100分门槛。退役该优化器状态候选，不扩大训练。
